text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I come to the school for an interview
with the
school's newspaper. After we
finish up...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I notice Mejiro Dober staring straight in
my
direction.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
How can they stay so calm with all those

cameras? I wish I could be like that...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: N-nothing. I didn't say anything.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Huh?! U-um, well...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
It's my problem, so it's none of your
concern.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober remains tight-lipped, but I

distinctly recall hearing her mumble "I
wish I could
be like that."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: What? How did you...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seems I hit the nail on the head.
Wanting to help
her out, I give her some
advice on how to be
more at ease with
having her photo taken.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Do... do you think you could teach me
some tips
on how to look good in
pictures?
choice_data_list: 体を鍛えて自信をつけよう！

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I don't like being the center of
attention... I have
a lot of trouble smiling
naturally for interviews
and such.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
But I really do want to be able to smile
boldly in
front of the camera.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...I didn't ask for your advice.
choice_data_list: 体を鍛えて自信をつけよう！

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Confidence...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Hmmm... Is that really all it takes? I
wonder if
that'll help me smile more
naturally.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...I'll give it a shot. I'll use what you've
said when I
train too. Thanks.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And with that, Mejiro Dober walks away.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if I'll really be able to smile
naturally if
I'm more confident in
myself...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...I suppose I could try it out if I feel like
it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: A mirror? You can't be serious...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Smile in front of a mirror? But that
sounds so
embarrassing...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Well...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I'll... keep that in mind.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
But it sounds easy enough to do, and it'll
be good
to see what I look like.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for your advice. I'll try it and
see how
it goes.
